༄༅/ /dmag zor mdos bzhugs so/ /swasti/dmag zor lha mo'i mdos kyi cho ga bya ba ni/ka to ra lta bu'i snod chen nas 'bru dngos gtsang gis gang ba'i na

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dmag zor mdos bzhugs so// swasti/ dmag zor lha mo'i mdos kyi cho ga bya ba ni/ ka to ra lta bu'i snod chen nas 'bru dngos gtsang gis gang ba'i nang snyug ma snal ma sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad spungs pa'i drung lha mchod pa dang rang 'thung ba'i chang bshams pa'i phud kyis dngul phor gtsang ma bkang la/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum/ yi dam gang rung gis bdud rtsi byin brlabs dang / phur mchod kyis 'thus pas/ 'dir phur pa la sbyar na/ de'i bdud rtsi byin brlabs dang / gser skyems rgyas bsdus gang rung byas la/ tshig bsgyur ni/ mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje yis/ /nyer dgongs byin brlabs dpal bskyed la/ /yul phyogs 'dis mtshon 'jig rten du/ /nad rims mug 'khrugs mi 'byung zhing / /grub gnyis sogs sam yang na 'jig rten du yan gong bzhin la/ char chu phebs shing lo phyugs legs/ /grub gnyis 'phel zhes sogs lta bu/ de bzhin du mdor na sum brgya drug cu rnams/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'dir bzhes la/ /yul phyogs gong bzhin/ gur zhal la'ang de bzhin sbyar/ phyogs skyong dang 'byung po la tshims byas nas zhes pa'i rjes su/ yul phyogs 'dis mtshon 'jig rten du/ /nad rims mug 'khrugs bsrung ba la/ /byer dang 'khu ldog sogs zhes sogs dang / rung nga phrag dog ces sogs dang / yang gong gi lo phyugs spel tshig ltar na/ char chu lo phyugs legs thabs la/ byer dang sogs༞ ru nga sogs༞ chang lhag de drong dang grogs rnams kyis skabs gang babs su btung bas chog de nas thal mo sbyar la/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyi ma thams cad dge ba yin/ /rgyu skar thams cad bzang ba yin/ /dgra bcom thams cad zag pa zad/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rdzu 'phrul che/ zhes lan cig dang / oṃ a ka ni/ ni ka ni/ a byi la/ maṇḍal la ma ye swāhā/ zhes lan bdun brjod la/ gso gang byas kyi de thams cad kyi sne dang phud rnams nas cung zad re bsdus la snod gcig tu bshams nas thog ka'am mgon khang gang rung du bskyal la/

'di skad brjod/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dkon mchog gsum yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ chos skyong / phyogs skyong gzhi bdag rnams dang / khyad par dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ dmag zor dgra lha'i rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa la gsog phud 'di rnams 'bul lo/ /bdag gi 'dod pa'i don thams cad bde blag tu 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod la 'og tu bshad pa bzhin/ mdos kyi gsob ci dgos byas pa de'i/ snyug ma bshags nas yon bdag gi rgyu cha'i tshod dang bstun la mdos che chung gang byed kyi tshad kyi snyug ma bshags nas/ 'a mo'i gsum cha tsam da lag pa la bya/ lag do ring bshos kyi rtse mo nas mnyam la/ sne mo byung sar lag sgar/ snyug ma'i rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nor bar bya/ rtse phyir bstan la btsugs/ tshon sna dkar dang dmar gyis drangs/ zhes pas nang nas dkar ser sngo dmar/ nag po phyir byas la/ rin po che'i nam mkha' gcig dkar rkyang gcig sngo rkyang gcig dmar rkyang gcig ser rkyang gcig nag po brgyad/ de bcu gsum byas la/ nam mkha' rnams kyi rtse mor bya nag gi sgro re/ phod du gzugs/ lag la bal nag gi 'phan gdags/ rgyang bu nag po bcu gsum/ mda' nag bcu gsum gyi steng la dar nag re re dang / yang mda' bzhi la dar dkar/ sngo dmar/ ser gdags/ som gyi 'phang nag bcu gsum bya'o/ /sa gur/ gnam gur rtsibs bcu gnyis ma dang / rtsibs brgyad ma sogs skabs su gang babs nang nas dkar ser/ sngo dmar/ nag po'i 'ja' can gnyis brtsegs kyi rtser bskang mdos la tsitta ris 'dzugs par gsungs pas/ de'i dbyangs ni nam mkha' stod ring la smad thung ba'o/ /de nas rlon gsog bya ba ni/ 'jim pa nag po la 'bru sna tshogs dang / khyad par 'bru nag po dang / rin chen sna lnga dang / dri bzang po'i sman sna lnga dang sbyar la/ gtso mo'i sku drel rta la zhon pa/ dmod mo'i mtshon cha lnga ni/ nad rkyal/

khram shing / cho long / rde'u dkar nag tshon sna lnga'i dru bu dang bcas pa sogs lha mo'i mngon rtogs gzhung nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin bya/ mi nag bcu gsum bya'o/ /lug lpags nag po che ba zhig la lug pags gzugs yongs rdzogs kyi rnam pa bcu gsum spras pa'i mgo dang rmig bzhi 'jim pa sogs la bcos pa/ de nas zan la rin po che sna brgyad/ dri'i sman lnga/ 'bru sna lnga rnams sbyar la/ ngar glud khru gang par bya ste/ de dang zho sha'i snying / lung thang mig mgron bu'i so/ thod pa lbalku/ mu tig gi klad pa/ zer mo'i skra/ lag pa gnyis la dbang po lag pa/ rkang pa gnyis la chu srin sder mo/ rkang g.yas lcags/ g.yon zangs la bya bar gsungs pas/ gnas de dang de dag tu rdzas so sor bcug la ngo bo mo gzugs mdzes ma bod chas can lta bu phyag len la mdzad srol yod cing / lag g.yas su gser/ g.yon du g.yu/ yon bdag gang yod kyi pho'i g.yas dang mo'i gos gang g.yon nas ras mal bsdus la glud kyi g.yas g.yon du bzhag de'i mthar me tog bza' btung / zang zing dngos po/ dri sna/ sman sna/ la zas lung zas 'bru sna/ rin chen sna/ pags rigs gos dar sna tshogs dang khyung sogs/ gnam la 'phur dgu/ seng ge sogs ri klung du 'gro dgu/ chu srin sogs chu sar 'jug dgu sna tshogs kyis bskor zan gyi bshos bu nag po bcu bzhi/ 'brang rgyas nag po bcu gsum/ bya nag bcu gsum rnams bsham mo/ thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzas bshams pa ni/ snod so sor/ me tog nag po/ khrag sna tshogs tshad/ grir bsad pa'i sha chen/ snying / khyad par skyes pa dar ma g.yul du bsad pa'i sha snying / bya nag gi snying / btsod/ zhu mkhan/ rgya skag rnams dang / g.yang gzhi/ rkang dung / g.yab dar nag po/ dngos sam bris 'bur gang rung gi lug nag mo/ bya mo nag mo/ dres nag rnams rta ru gzugs pa ni rdzas bshams pa'o/ /bdag bskyed phur chen byed na de'i sman raka gtor gsum dang rjes 'brel/

yi dam chos skyong gzhan gyi gtor bsngo bskang gso byed na so so'i mchod gtor rang rang gi phyag len bzhin/ khyad par dmag zor rgyal mo'i gtor bsngo bskang gso'i mchod gtor ni sngags 'chang chen po'i gsung rab/ dmag zor ma'i sgos bskang las/ stegs kyi steng du nas la sogs pa'i 'bru bkram/ de steng rdzas la sogs pa'i snod gtsang ma gnyis kyi gcig tu 'di nyid kyi dam rdzas gtor ma dkar gtor zlum po pad 'dab brgyad kyis bskor ba mar gyis rgyan ci mdzes dang shas brgyan pa/ snod gcig tu bskang ba'i gtor ma zur gsum la khrag gtsang ma'am/ smug rtsis byug pa la mar gyis thod pa'i steng du nor bu 'bar ba/ gtor mtha' la me ri ci mdzes byed/ mdun du bshos bu dmar po bzhi ste gtor ma lnga ka mar dang shas brgyan pa/ gtso gtor bya nag rta g.yag khyi lug dom/ spyang ki/ bya mo rnams kyi gzugs zan nag po las bzos pa btsugs/ 'byor na mda' dar nag po yang gzugs/ gtor ma'i g.yas su sman phud chang gtsang ma la 'byor na bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa g.yon du rakta khrag gtsang ma'am chang la sha dmar btab la/ sman raka snod mi thod dam ting la sogs pa gang 'byor du bshams/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod lnga dang / phud chang gtsang ma/ lha mo'i sgos kyi spos tshil chen nam/ sha chen/ gu gul/ cong bzhi/ mngal khrag rnams bsres pa'i bdug spos/ ma 'byor na gu gul/ rang gi mdun du stegs ji ltar rigs pa la rdor dril/ ḍā ma ru/ nang mchod dang / gzhan yang rnga sil/ mi rkang gi gling bu sogs dgos pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba med par 'du bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bshams/ thugs dam bskang ba'i mdos bshams pa ni/ slang nga'am/ phub kyi steng du gong du bshad pa'i sku rgyu'i ri rab zlum po bang rim gsum pa'i steng du gru gsum khrag gi rgya mtsho'i steng du lha mo'i sku dar nag gi na bza' can bzhag

de'i rgyab tu srog shing la sa gur gnam gur gnyis brtsegs nang dar ljang khus g.yogs pa'i phyi'i rtser tsitta ris bya rog sgro'i phod chen btsugs/ lha mo'i mdun/ rin chen nam mkha' ri rab kyi dbus su gzugs/ bang rim dang po'i shar lho nub byang rnams su/ dkar sngo dmar ser gyi nam mkha' dang nam mkha' nag po re/ rgyang bu'i grangs kyang de mtshungs mtshams bzhi yang rgyang nag po re/ bar ma la shar du mda' gsum dang / lho byang nub gsum du gnyis re/ mtshams bzhi re re/ 'og ma la 'phang nag 'dzugs tshul mda' bzhin gyi rtse mor bya nas der bskyon pa dang phyogs bzhir gling bzhi'i mdog dang mthun pa'i mda' dar dang gong gi pags nag bcu bzhi mda' 'phang bkod pa ltar gzugs/ ri rab kyi mthar mi nag yan lag dang skye mched rnams dod par byas pa gtso mor kha bstan la 'god/ de'i phyir bshos bu/ de'i phyir 'brang rgyas kyis bskor/ kun gyi mtha' nas 'jim nag gi lcags ris bskor/ slang snod yin na lcags ri mi dgos/ lha mo'i g.yon slang nga'i nang du ngar mi'i kha lha mo la bstan pa ting lo sbar chog ma gsum bcas bzhag mdos kyi drung du sman raka drag po'i mchod pa rnams gong gtor drung bzhin bshams pa ste/ mdos dang glud bshams pa'o/ /'don pa'i rim 'dir bdag bskyed phur chen bya ba'i dbang du btang nas thog mar gnas yo byin brlabs kyi rol mo byin 'bebs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang rung / phur chen/ dbyangs yod med gang rung rig 'dzin bskul rdzogs pa'i bar bya/ yi dam chos skyong gzhan gyi gtor bsngo bskang ba dang dmag zor ma'i gtor bsngo sgos bskang sogs gang dgos byas la/ rdor glu/ bkra shis smon lam phul pa'i tshogs 'bul bshags pa'i bar bya/ de nas rnga brdung dang bcas/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /zhes sogs bla ma spyi bstod shlau ka gcig

ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che sogs mchog gsum spyi bstod shlau ka gcig de mtshams bdag bskyed gang byas kyi yi dam la bstod dgos pas 'dir/ gru gsum mthing nag sogs phur bstod shlau ka gcig phan bde'i bstan pa skyong mdzad cing sogs mgon po spyi bstod gur mgon gzungs chog nas 'byung ba bzhin shlau ka gcig bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'joms/ /dpa' bo gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa/ /rdo rje gzhon nur phyag 'tshal zhing / /phyogs skyong bcu yi tshogs la bstod/ /ces shlau ka 'khyar bsdus 'di rnams yug gcig la btang nas phyogs skyong gi mthar tshig rol bya/ sngags 'chang chen po'i dmag zor sgos bskang bsdus pa nas 'byung ba'i bcom ldan gshin rje gshed sogs bstod pa shlau ka gcig la rdo rje 'chang dbang ma'i dbyangs rol tshar gnyis kye kye ma gcig sogs nas 'dur shur gang rung / dgra bgegs rtsad nas la tshig rol bde gshegs spyi bskul lam/ dkon mchog spyi bskul rta mgrin yang gsang nas 'byung ba de 'dir sbyar ba la 'gal ba cung zad kyang med de phur pa bsgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi gras yin pas so/ /des na bde gshegs spyi bskul dpal ldan seng ges mdzad pa 'dir byas la/ dbang chen khrag 'thung zhes sogs kyi tshig bsgyur dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor dang bcas zhes pa bsgyur/ rnal 'byor bcol ba'i la tshig rol gsum brdung bcas kyi mthar nyis brdeg 'phar ma dus mdos nam gru ma'i 'og bzhin blang la rkang gling g.yab dar spos dud bcas/ spyan 'dren phyogs phyogs ma shlau ka gsum la de wi ko ṭi'i dbyangs shlau ka re'i mtshams su rol mo rkang gling g.yab dar/ be con nas 'dur shur gang rigs dmag zor lha mo la tshig rol gyi mthar chems brdung nag mo gdug can sogs shlau ka gcig la tshig rol chems brdung gsum brdeg len can rol bskor 'bebs bcas/ mdos kyi mchod pa mgon po drug cu pa'i 'go bzhin byin gyis brlabs la dgra bgegs rnams kyis sogs la bdud rtsi lnga mchod kyi gdangs/

lo rim yin na 'bul gyi rjes su 'jig rten bde zhing sogs shlau ka gcig oṃ shrī ye de wi ma hā kā li sa pa ri wa ra ma hā rakta sa mu dra sogs bdud rtsi lnga mchod nang bzhin/ 'og gi tshigs bcad so so'i mthar yang mtshan sngags 'di bzhin dang mchod sngags bdud rtsi lnga mchod bzhin shes par bya'o/ /rgyun du ni bzhes nas mi mthun rkyen dbang bzlog /ces sogs las 'jig rten bde zhing sogs brjod mi dgos/ rkang gling rnga sgra'i 'gor bcom dung bcom rol rkang gling sogs dril bu dam tshig ma bzhin/ de'i dbyangs bcas tshig rkang dang po'i dbyangs la rkang gling 'bud/ lo rim la/ yid la 'dod kun 'grub pa dang / bcol ba'i sogs/ dbyangs rol thams cad dril bu dam tshig ma bzhin no/ /de nas phra mo sbom po nas sngags bsngo'i phrin bcol rdzogs pa'i bar sgos bskang bzhin/ chos dbyings spros bral ma dbyangs bcas rgyun bzhin/ dpal ldan rtsa brgyud sogs bshags pa rgyas pa dbyangs bcas/ mdos sngags drug gi byin gyis brlabs/ bcom dung bcom rol bsangs bzhin byas la/ bhyoḥm ni dges chen sogs shlau ka gcig la shar phyogs sgo srung ma'i dbyangs rol/ ma ni sku gsung sogs nas 'dur shur gang rung / dbang du bsdus la tshig rol/ nga rgyal bskyed pa shlau ka gcig la de'i dbyangs dang / skye med ma'i rol mo dbyangs tsho gnyis ka'i 'gor hūm̐ nga nga zhes sbyar/ khro rgyal gshin rje gshed ces pa 'dir bdag bskyed gang byas la tshig bsgyur dgos pas da lan/ nga ni khro rgyal ki la ya zhes bsgyur/ nga ni khams gsum nas/ yon bdag la tshig rol/ hūm̐ khams gsum nas/ de ring srid gsum la tshig rol bhyoḥdeng 'dir nas/ bzlog bsgyur la tshig rol/ ma mo srid rgyal shlau ka gcig la/ gzhan yang ma 'bring po nam gru ma'i dbyangs rol/ shākya thub pa nas rdzas bdag chen mo la tshig rol/ de nas ngar ma'i mdun gyi ting lo gsum sbar la hūm̐ bhyoḥ

glud mchog nas byin brlabs pa'i bar la yang dag don du ma'i dbyangs rol/ 'bras bu sku gsum nas sgyur byed ma'i dus la bab la tshig rol/ 'dir yan 'dur shur gang rung yin/ 'di man thams cad la rnga stabs 'phar brdung dang bcas hūm̐ bhyoḥ sna tshogs sogs kyi mthar/ ma mo mkha' lding gi rjes kyi rdzas bdag la tshig rol/ kye bhyoḥsogs kyi mthar/ bzlog bsgyur la tshig rol hūm̐ bhyoḥ lnga brgya sogs kyi mtha'i bzlog bsgyur thams cad la tshig rol/ bhyoḥ dpal ldan gnyen gyi nas/ bzhes shig gi bar la/ shwa thung gi dbyangs rol bhyo/ dpal ldan gnyan gyi re ma ti/ 'bar ba mi byed sogs nas/ phyi 'khor skyong zhing gi mtha'i rdzas bdag la tshig rol/ kye bhyoḥri ti mgo yag nas/ yon bdag drin lan la tshig rol/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ gsang chen nas dam tshig nyams chags bskang la tshig rol/ 'di gras thod rnga rkang gling sgra yis mchod la rkang gling gdangs bcas/ de nas zhwa gyon la/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ dpal chen nas/ mi mthun zhes pa thams cad la/ tshig rol che gsum/ dgu brdung gsum che gcig rnams la rkang gling / byang gi mtha'i/ mi mthun tshig rol dgu brdung gsum che gcig rnams rdzogs nas/ chems brdung gsum brdeg len can/ dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti sogs sangs rgyas bstan srung ma rgyas par bzhin/ 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub gyur cig gi rjes su/ rol mo blangs la dgu brdung gnyis/ sgos bskang gi bzlog pa rgyas pa/ dgu brdung chems brdung dkar dung la drag dung zangs dung la til gsum brdeg len can/ spyi bstabs sogs 'phros rnams rgyun bzhin no/ /'dzugs mdos yin na/ dpal chen mgon po sogs phyogs bzhi'i bskul rdzogs nas gang du 'dzugs sa der bskyal grub nas bstod bzlog sogs bya/ gtor mdos yin na gtor 'bul dang mnyam du phyir ri rtse sogs su bskyal/ 'di bdag bskyed phur chen byas pa'i dbang du btang nas bsgral mchod lhag ma bstan skyong rnams nyin rjes ma la bya dgos pas de nyin bsgral mchod rdzogs nas mdos gzhung bzlog pa bcas btang mthar lhag ma spyi bstabs bstan skyong sogs bya'o/

/zhes pa'ang sa skya pa kun blos bris/ yang gtor 'bul phyir byed pa dang chabs cig mdos 'bul ba spro na/ lhag ma'i dbang phyug ma rdzogs pa'i/ bcol pa'i phrin las bsgrub par mdzod kyi rjes su gsum brdeg len can blangs/ rang rang gi gral nas langs la/ las kyi rdo rje sogs kyis thog mar gser skyems/ mchod gtor/ bstan skyong gi gtor ma sogs khyer mi bsgrigs pa'i rjes su mdos glud rnams sgo phyogs la zhal bsgyur nas khyer chog bya/ re ma ti dang bdud 'dul ma'i dbyangs le tshan gzhung rnams dang bcas pa rdzogs nas/ bzhi brdung rjes ma rim myur dang bstun lhag 'gros kyis lhag ma 'di gtor ma sgo'i phyir thon pa dang rol mo de kha'i mur sgang dung dang sarba a na ya'i sngags/ de nas rkang gling g.yab dar gtor bzlog bzhin rol mo de kha'i mu nas phyir thon ran pa dang dar mdung rgya gling spos phor ba gong gi lhag gtor gyi rjes su mchod gtor mdos rnga rol sogs phyin la mtshams mtshams su sgang dung dang rkang gling g.yab dar bya zhing gser skyems gtor/ phyi rol ji ltar rigs par lhag ma gtor mdos rnams bzhag rnga rol gral bsgrigs tshar ba dang chems brdung gi rjes su gsum brdeg len can/ de nas 'phar chen gcig 'then rkang gnyis/ lnga brdeg 'then rkang che gcig pu tra bskul rgyun bzhin la rol mo thams cad la rkang gling sgang dung chig brdung gi mu nas mdos skyel sa der phyin gral gong bzhin bsgrigs tshar rjes/ sgang dung bcu bzhi brdeg sogs/ ja yod na bcom dung bcom rol sogs rgyun bzhin/ med na spyi btab nam mkha' 'brug sgra'i dbyangs tshugs la/ gong ltar gtor 'bul gyi mtha'i bla med ma'i rol mo gsum brdeg de nas che gcig nyis brdeg len med/ dmag zor ma'i sgos bstabs la nged rang dran skabs thams cad dbang sdud ma'i dbyangs mdzad srol 'dug kyang de ma yin te/

gal te thams cad dbang sdud ma'i dbyangs yin na/ bhyoḥwā wā/ dpal ldan zhes 'byung rigs pa dang / de'i sngon du 'gro ba'i spyi bstabs dpal ldan gru 'dzin mar yang de dang gnyis/ gnyis med ma'i dbyangs 'jog mi dgos pas/ da lta dmag zor ma'i sgos bstabs kyi tshe spyi bstabs la dpal ldan gru 'dzin ma nges par mdzad pa ni/ dmag zor ma'i sgos bstabs la de dang gnyis med ma yin no/ /zhes ston byed la the tshom med pas/ des na dmag zor ma'i sgos bstabs kyi dbyangs ni de dang gnyis med ma yin pas shlau ka gcig dang / de nas tshig rkang lnga/ yang tshig rkang lnga bcas gsum la de dang gnyis med ma'i dbyangs rol tshar gsum 'dir gshegs ma la mi pham ma'i ma bhyoḥm bcug ste/ da bcol legs pa'i gsol 'debs chen por dbul bar la ma bhyoḥma'i dbyangs rol tshar gsum/ dpon slob srung zhing man rgyun bzhin 'dur shur gang rung gi rol mo rkang gling bcas kyi mthar chems brdung lan gnyis/ drag dung lan gnyis kyi rjes mar rkang gling bcas lhag gtor phud chang gtor bsngo dang bskang ba'i gtor ma phul/ mdos ma bsgyel ba drang por bzhag pa de nyid kyi mtha' nas shing gis bskor ma me sbar te zhugs su phul bas 'gad gtsang / zhugs me bzhes pa 'jim sku dang glud srog chags kyi gzugs 'gros rnams chus sbyangs/ de ltar rung ba'i shes byed kyang sbyin bsreg dang / zor mdos mer sbyong bar/ sku dang sātstsha chu sbyongs ba de nyid kyi rigs 'gres shes/ 'di man la rkang gling mi dgos/ de nas rnga rol bzhag bstan skyong gi 'go'i tshig lhug dang / yang rnga rol byas la bstan skyong gi dbyangs dang rol mo sogs rgyun bzhin/ phur pa'i gtsor gtor gyi smad dang bstan skyong gi gtor ma phud chang bcas phul/ chems brdung rdzogs mthar/ sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig gnyis gsum zhes dang / tshig brdung gi mu nas sgrub khang phyogs su log la/

mtshams mtshams su sgang dung re 'bud cing / bde yang lta bur slebs pa dang byang phyogs su kha bltas la srid zhi dpal 'byor ma'i dbyangs rol rgyun bzhin/ sgrub khang du log gral la 'khod nas/ ye shes lnga ldan sogs mjug chog bya zhing / bla ma yi dam chos skyong nor lha'i bkra shis dang / tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub pa sogs shis pa brjod pa'i tshig du ma me tog gi char dang bcas pa'i mthar rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya'o// //zhes pa'ang sa skya pa kun blos bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dmag zor mdos/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
